protocol.dataset: 10 users; hardware ACC; closed known identities
protocol.encoder: frozen pure ACC CE 42/43/44 from prior matched episodic controls
protocol.grouping: fixed cyclic word order; 3-word last trial reuses first record once to retain all20 records
protocol.quality: training 5th percentile log-RMS proxy; no measured SNR/dropout/clipping available
protocol.retry: at most one backup recording per low-energy word; no score-based retry
protocol.policy: reject after low-quality backup; all trials retained
protocol.threshold: per-target/length/backend/policy development FAR<=5%, then minimum FRR; frozen before query
protocol.scope: historical words reassigned to allow5 unseen-in-encoder development and5 query prompts; exploratory
protocol.uncertainty: few non-overlapping groups; 3word one-record overlap; no independence-based confidence claim
protocol.ranking_metrics: EER nearest empirical FAR/FRR intersection average; quality rejects tied below all remaining scores; AUC includes all trials

validation: 780 unique configurations; all development FAR<=5%; all trial counts verified
